entities.summary: Yevhen Fylymonovych Malaniuk was a Ukrainian poet, literary critic and community activist. His poetry belongs to the finest examples created by the 1920-1930s generation in Ukrainian literature. Malaniuk's works became influential in Ukrainian emigré circles, but were banned in Ukraine itself during the Soviet rule as a result of his nationalist views.
